metadata.title: क्रिसमस के मौके पर डिलिस्टिंग की रैली | Delisting of converted Adivasis rally on Christmas
metadata.description: The issue of delisting converted Adivasis from the Scheduled Tribes list in India, which has been resolved by both Parliament and the Supreme Court, remains a topic of discussion due to the efforts of organizations such as Janjati Suraksha Manch. Despite the resolution, the organization has actively kept the issue alive by organizing 124 public meetings in recent months to build momentum for a movement. This organisation claims that converted tribals are taking double the benefits of minority and Scheduled tribes. The focus has now shifted to Tripura, where the organization continues its advocacy efforts. This ground report highlights the persistence of the issue and the ongoing efforts to mobilize support for the cause.
